messages:
tess.sales: Hey team, Acme POC is blocked. Customer reports 403 when hitting /v1/infer with their service key. Response body: {"error":"invalid_project"}. They say same key works for embeddings. POC demo tomorrow morning. Curl they used:
```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-zzzz' -H 'X-ORG-ID: org-acme' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -d '{"input":"hi"}' -v```
omar.platform: @tess.sales can you share response headers (x-rw-error, x-rw-tenant, x-rw-project)? Also which region?
tess.sales: headers: `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden`, `x-rw-error: InvalidProjectBinding`, `x-rw-tenant: org-acme`, no x-rw-project header. Region: eu-central-1.
raj.dev: likely a project binding issue: inference endpoints require either an org-scoped key or project header if key is project-bound. If embeddings worked it may be using a different endpoint that falls back to org.
lisa.security: quick note for audit: confirm the key's scopes and owner via internal key lookup. @ivy.engineering can you run key-inspect?
ivy.engineering: ran inspect: `sk-acme-zzzz -> owner: org-acme, project: project-77, scopes: [inference:invoke]` 
ivy.engineering: interestingly scopes include inference:invoke but project is project-77. Customer's project is project-88. So requests without X-PROJECT-ID default to project in key, and mismatch triggers invalid_project.
tess.sales: customer insists they didn't create multiple projects. How do they proceed quickly for demo?
omar.platform: two options: 1) they can add header `X-PROJECT-ID: project-77` to match key binding; or 2) rotate a new key bound to org-acme (org-scoped) so no project header required. For quick demo, add header.
raj.dev: also double-check hostname: eu vs global. Project routing is per-region; if they call wrong region host we may reject. Make sure `eu-central-1` host is used.
lisa.security: we'll note for the security questionnaire: keys bound to projects are stronger for least privilege. Recommend update to SSO provisioning docs.
infra-bot: Scheduled job: key-rotate-scan completed for org-acme, 3 keys flagged for ambiguous bindings.
ivy.engineering: customer added `X-PROJECT-ID: project-77` and now infer returns 200. Confirmed model `gpt-3.2-slim`, latency ~120ms.
tess.sales: sweet, customer can finish demo. Any follow-ups?
raj.dev: logging action item: add clearer error text for invalid_project to include suggestion to set X-PROJECT-ID or rotate to org-scoped key. Filing ticket INF-4021.
olivia.ops: (private) will follow up with customer on key rotation and update sales playbook about headers.
tess.sales: thanks everyone, I'll update the account exec and include the quick remediation steps for the handoff. :rocket:
